title: coding-study sets.yaml
description: A workspace's problem sets: named, ordered lists of problems and items. Spec: docs/specs/cli.md#cstudy-set. coding_study.domain.problem_sets reads the same shape.

sets.description: Each set by its name, in the order the views list them

problems.description: Slugs of problems and items, in study order. A slug the catalog no longer has is allowed and shows as missing

oneOf.description: An entry with a target: a progressive or project problem is done in the set once a pass reaches this level, every level when it names none (docs/decisions/0024-level-passes.md#target-levels-in-sets). The same `level` as a learning path's problem step
